messages:
alexa: Heads-up — noticed SLO alert previews in Console are showing raw threshold values (e.g. 99.0) but not the configured sampling window or quota. Hard to tell whether a spike is real or sampled. Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/s/slo-preview.

dario: That's because the preview card pulls the metric but not the evaluation config. We only fetch 'effective_rate' for perf.

neha: We should surface both the evaluation window (e.g. 5m, 1h) and the 'sampled' badge when the rule is using sampling/quota. Otherwise responders assume full fidelity.

sam: Agreed. Also noticed per-tenant notify-weights aren't shown. When a route is sampled at 10% the UI currently still shows the channel as "active" with no hint. That's misleading.

alexa: Minimal repro: create SLO with rollingWindow=1h, sampling={type: rate, pct:10, quota:100/day}, attach notify: primary=#infra, fallback=#infra-2. Console preview shows threshold breach but no sampling annotation.

```json
{
  "slo": {"id":"svc-x","threshold":99.0,"window":"1h"},
  "sampling": {"type":"rate","pct":10,"quota":"100/day"},
  "notify": {"primary":"#infra","fallback":"#infra-2"}
}
```

neha: UX proposal: show a line under the numeric threshold: "evaluated across 1h (10% sampling, 100/day quota)" and a small tooltip explaining how sampling works + a link to runbook. Add icon :mag_right: for sampled.

dario: Backend: currently /v1/slo/preview returns metrics + simplified notify. I don't want to bloat that endpoint with full sampling config for every preview request across many tenants. We already paginate previews. Maybe add optional query param `include_eval_config=true`.

sam: That sounds reasonable. UI can request eval config only when user clicks 'details' or if user has role 'oncall'. Default is lightweight.

alexa: One more thing: when sampling kicks in, alerting routing can downtier (send to audit-only channel). Need the Console to show effective route (what will actually be used). Right now it shows configured route. Big mismatch.

neha: We must be careful with privacy: don't show email addresses for fallback contacts in compact preview. Channels are fine. Add a mapping to redact emails unless expanded.

dario: API change proposal: PATCH /v1/slo/preview?include_eval_config=true -> returns fields: eval_window, sampling_summary, effective_notify (what will be used after sampling/quota rules applied). Effective_notify can be a small object: {"channels": ["#infra"], "mode": "audit"}. Keep it tiny.

alexa: Telemetry: emit events `slo_preview.expanded` when user requests eval config and `slo_preview_shows_sampling` when UI renders the sampled badge. Include tenant_id and slo_id but not tenant PII.

sam: Rollout: feature-flag `slo-preview-eval-config`. Start with internal tenants + beta. We'll need a migration doc for the Console and API client libs.

neha: Also add a quick "test playback" button on the preview that simulates 1 breach (respects sampling) and shows which channels would be notified. That helps oncall verify behavior without touching prod alerts. Could be limited to users with 'sre' role.

dario: Implementing test playback as POST /v1/slo/preview/playback {slo_id, simulate: {window, breaches}} returns "would_notify": ["#infra"] and a short log. We'll rate-limit and require auth.

alexa: Nice. That also helps for runbooks and runbook links.

ops-bot: deploy: canary roll started for eng-platform/backend sha=def456 -> env=staging

sam: I'll draft a small RFC with API shapes and telemetry event names, assign @dario for API impl, @neha for UX copy and redaction rules, @alexa to own playback gating.

dario: I'll sketch API and add param `include_eval_config=true` and the playback endpoint. ETA: PR by Fri.

neha: I'll mock the UI changes and include accessibility notes for the sampled badge.

alexa: Thanks folks. Priorities: P1 for clarity (show sampling), P2 for playback test, P3 for full effective_notify expansion.

sam: Filed task: ENG-PLAT-5123. :white_check_mark:
